This topic is part of the OCR GCSE Art & Design specification.

Critical and Contextual Studies appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

The OCR board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Critical and Contextual Studies.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
